title: PhD/MPhil Astronomy and Astrophysics (2027 entry)
institution: The University of Manchester, Jodrell Bank Centre for Astrophysics
about: Jodrell Bank Centre for Astrophysics lists PhD projects for 2027 entry, including work linked to the Euclid mission. Applications must arrive by 22 January 2027 for STFC funding consideration; other funding schemes require submission by 4 January 2027.
requirements: For full consideration for STFC funding, applications must reach the university by Friday 22 January 2027
Other funding schemes: latest submission Monday 4 January 2027
Contact prospective supervisors and rank your top three projects in the application
STFC studentship interviews usually mid to late February
